reply_text:
I replied in #central-team's thread on Priyanka's message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April date: the brain has no renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

The reply points her to the signed order form, or to Marcus Lindqvist, who had the account in a 2025 handoff note.

One thing to check: the reply mentions a North team cheat sheet and that 2025 note. Priyanka isn't in the North channels, so the reference to those pages goes slightly beyond what she can see. The posted message contains no figures or contract contents. If you'd rather not reference those pages, the message can be edited or deleted.
